scope: Standalone Emberdeep camp menu and launcher icon
reported_problems: Main menu appeared near the floor
Pinching did not activate menu buttons
implemented: Wait for valid headset tracking and a stable pose before revealing the world menu; do not place using a four-second timeout fallback.
Place the menu centre at the headset camera eye height, 1.05 metres forward along horizontal heading. Keep it anchored until explicit recenter, origin reset or focus/tracking recovery.
Validate actual tracking origin and raw floor pose so a prefab camera height offset cannot make the initial zero pose look valid.
Use head-directed gaze, immediate button tint and cyan outline, plus a cursor and hand-readiness instructions. Eye tracking is not required.

Activate with a fresh thumb/index pinch from either hand using the existing tracked-joint adapter and pinch hysteresis. A held pinch cannot activate newly gazed targets or click through a page transition.
Main menu offers New Game, Settings and Quit; Continue is shown when the in-memory expedition has started. New Game enters the fireground directly.
Settings offers persistent sound on/off and menu recenter. Quit opens a Cancel or Yes Quit confirmation and explains current lack of persistent expedition saves.
Standalone Quest and PICO builds use the custom Emberdeep icon and version code 2. Build-time Android icon overrides are restored after building.
design_decision: For the repaired camp menu, use a 0.35-second stable-pose acquisition rather than the earlier proposed 0.5-second plus two-second countdown. This supersedes that proposal for the camp menu only. Fireground placement and the broader proposed v0.2 gameplay remain separate work.

build_delivery.result: Both release builds succeeded. APK signatures, hashes, version code, scene whitelist and extracted launcher icons verified. Original shared-project PlayerSettings and EditorBuildSettings restored byte-for-byte.

historical_iterations.user_report: The user reports that hand-tracked buttons remain unusable and explicitly requests index-finger ray pointing plus pinch click. This is a failed interaction acceptance report; it does not revoke the earlier front-position confirmation or establish a specific device identity.
interaction: Camp, settings, quit confirmation, fireground HUD and gear shop share one index-ray UI adapter. The headset pose places the menu but does not select buttons.

Each tracked hand uses its own index knuckle-to-tip direction, visible thin cyan ray and cursor. Retain the last open index origin and direction in palm space while the finger curls to pinch; wrist rotation still aims the ray.
Only a new pinch from the hand pointing at a settled button may activate that button. Another hand cannot confirm its target. Simultaneous pinches select at most one action.
Reuse MetaShadowPlayer tracked joints, ShadowPinchGesture hysteresis and WorkshopButton actions. No parallel SDK UI dispatcher is added.
Tracking loss, invalid joints, focus/pause loss, page transitions and interaction ownership changes clear the pending gesture. Recovery requires opening the hand again.
Pointing at gameplay UI cancels weapon charge before activation. A supply-locked tool permits only REFILL ASSIST; accepted UI input is consumed before any refill gesture.
